info.title: Sphericon Telemetry API
info.description:
The anonymous Telemetry report an Instance sends once a day (ADR 0032). The receiver is a
separate service outside this repository; this document is the contract between the two.

post.description: Receives one Telemetry report. The receiver stores no source address.

204.description: There is no content to send for this request, but the headers may be useful.

OrderOfMagnitude.description: A count rounded to its order of magnitude, never an exact number.

schemaVersion.description: The version of this schema the report was built against.

instanceId.description: A random value stored in the Instance's database, derived from nothing.

appVersion.description: The release version of the running binary, for example `1.4.2`.

os.description: The operating system the binary runs on (Go's GOOS), for example `linux`.

arch.description: The CPU architecture the binary runs on (Go's GOARCH), for example `arm64`.

postgresMajor.description: The major version of the Postgres server, for example `17`.

instanceAgeDays.description: Whole days since the Instance was first started.

emailsSent30d.description: Emails sent in the last 30 days.

usedBroadcasts30d.description: A Broadcast was sent in the last 30 days.

automationsActive.description: At least one Automation is active.

usedTracker30d.description: The tracker recorded a visit in the last 30 days.

usedExternalApi30d.description: An external API token was used in the last 30 days.

webhooksConfigured.description: At least one webhook endpoint is configured.

integrationKinds.description: The kinds of sending Integration in use, each at most once.

TelemetryReport.description:
What an Instance reports about itself. It carries no name, slug, domain, address, host, error
text, licence key or exact number, and nothing that identifies a Workspace or a person. A new
field is a change to this schema and to its documentation in the same commit.
